name: PR416 ApplyKick + rolling pair ablation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-kick-rolling-pair.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  mechanism-census:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply exact ApplyKick + rolling removals
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-applykick-height-focused evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-applykick-height-focused -- src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs)" = "9d990db8463cb6fb800633cd777d529fbad9b63c"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs)" = "3297dd5a90c8881c510fa1869d34821d395f2a7f"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallPhysicsCore.cs)" = "e6df5a1be442d5ffb1ab6f6153417a758253e4c6"
          git diff --check 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad -- src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs
          cp .github/evidence/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run mechanism census
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-census
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=MeasurePr416MechanismCensus" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-kick-rolling-census.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-census \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-census/console.log

      - name: Upload census evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-kick-rolling-census-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-census/
          if-no-files-found: error

  focused-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Apply exact ApplyKick + rolling removals
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-applykick-height-focused evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-applykick-height-focused -- src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs)" = "9d990db8463cb6fb800633cd777d529fbad9b63c"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs)" = "3297dd5a90c8881c510fa1869d34821d395f2a7f"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallPhysicsCore.cs)" = "e6df5a1be442d5ffb1ab6f6153417a758253e4c6"
          git diff --check 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad -- src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run focused targets
        id: tests
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-focused
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "FullyQualifiedName~MatchEngineTackleTests|Name=sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-kick-rolling-focused.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-focused \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-focused/console.log

      - name: Enforce strict five-target TRX Passed outcomes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import glob, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          targets = {
              "AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed",
              "BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose",
              "TacklesHappenInComposedPlay",
              "ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice",
              "sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes",
          }
          files = glob.glob("artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-focused/*.trx")
          if len(files) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"expected one TRX, found {files}")
          root = ET.parse(files[0]).getroot()
          seen = {}
          for elem in root.iter():
              if elem.tag.endswith("UnitTestResult"):
                  name = elem.attrib.get("testName")
                  if name in targets:
                      seen[name] = elem.attrib.get("outcome")
          print("STRICT_TARGET_OUTCOMES", seen)
          missing = targets - seen.keys()
          bad = {k:v for k,v in seen.items() if v != "Passed"}
          if missing or bad:
              raise SystemExit(f"strict target failure missing={sorted(missing)} bad={bad}")
          PY

      - name: Upload focused evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-kick-rolling-focused-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-kick-rolling-focused/
          if-no-files-found: error
